name: DNA meiotic recombinase 1

function.text: DMC1 encodes meiotic recombination protein DMC1 homolog. Annotated molecular activities include DNA strand exchange activity and ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity. It participates in spermatogenesis and mitotic recombination.
